claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Nifurtimox is a nitroheterocyclic prodrug that requires reductive activation by parasite type I nitroreductases; human cancer cells lack this activating enzyme, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive, with any killing reflecting nonspecific oxidative/nitroreductive stress rather than a shared targeted mechanism.
